I can't say whether this asset has lost tree cover since 2020. The analysis didn't produce any observations.

The land-change run (run-1, 12 Nov 2026) started with a 2020-12-31 baseline and a 30% tree-cover threshold. The zonal statistics step then failed with this message: "the source coverage this asset needs has not been prepared; no observation was made." So there are no loss figures, no event areas, and no comparison with the JRC 2020 reference. The asset area also came back empty.

This result doesn't show that there was no loss. It only shows that nothing was measured.

To get an answer, the source coverage for ASSET-J needs to be prepared and the run repeated. The engine is also labeled early access, so check any later results with that in mind. I can interpret the output once a run completes.
